LO-1.learner_does: Subtracts two 2-digit numbers with regrouping, producing a correctly reduced tens digit and a correct final answer, unaided.

LO-2.learner_does: Explains why one ten is crossed out of the tens column when ten ones are added to the ones column, with support.

LO-3.learner_does: Checks their own two-digit subtraction work by verifying the crossed-out ten, the regrouped ones digit, and the final difference, unaided.

rows.text: Given two 2-digit numbers written in column form where the top ones digit is smaller than the bottom ones digit, the learner will compute the difference using regrouping, producing a correctly reduced tens digit and a correct final answer.
Given a column subtraction that requires borrowing, the learner will explain why one ten is crossed out of the tens column when ten ones are added to the ones column.
Given a two-digit subtraction they have just attempted, the learner will check their own work by verifying the crossed-out ten, the regrouped ones digit, and the final difference.
